why_this_is_a_gate: These are not snapshots of what the checker currently prints.  Every row
is taken from WHETSTONE_DAG.md, which pinned them BEFORE Grand Portage
existed, against three errors that actually shipped.  The generic checker
reading the DAG as data must reproduce the hardcoded checker's verdicts
The severity column is the sharper half.  whetstone_dag.py ASSIGNED
severities by hand and said so ('the severity grading is mine, not the
repo's', WHETSTONE_DAG.md sec.6 INFERRED item 2).  Grand Portage DERIVES
them from contradictions present in the graph.  Agreement on 3 of 4 is a
real result; the 4th is declared as an override with a reason, which is
the honest way to carry a judgement that is not a fact about the graph.

THREE ENTRIES ARE NOT RETRODICTIONS. The VACUOUS-CONCLUSION rows come from a rule added in v0.2.1, after a live run recorded an exact-checked cap slope at a model the same batch proved empty. They are marked pinned_as: null so the retrodiction claim stays exactly what it was -- the prototypes' flags, reproduced -- and does not quietly absorb detections the prototypes never made.

TRANSPORT:INF-C08-HIST.note: Error 1, shipped in public v0.3.2.  UNSOUND_CONCLUSION is derived, not assigned: CL-C08-REAL records real torus points on RES08_K, so the refused conclusion is FALSE rather than merely unproved.

TRANSPORT:INF-SLICEPHI.note: Error 3, the chart error: PREDICATE moved ALONG a NECESSARY_CONDITION edge.  No claim in the graph contradicts the conclusion, so the derivation stops at UNSOUND_PREMISE -- which is what whetstone_dag.py graded it by hand.

TRANSPORT:INF-A10-SURV.note: THE ONE DISAGREEMENT, and it is instructive.  The project's recorded wording was correct, so TRIAGE is right -- but that is a fact about what was historically asserted, not about the graph.  Carried as a declared override with a reason rather than smuggled into the derivation.

TAINT:SLICEPHI.note: INF-SLICEPHI-KILL's own emptiness transport IS licensed, but the model was BUILT by a refused step.  Provenance is tracked separately from transport.

COVERAGE:WINDOW:place.note: Error 2, the gauge leaks.  Must fire at exactly t, and at NEITHER y NOR inf, both of which have declared components.

COVERAGE:GSYS:order.pinned_as: NOT a reproduction -- P3 and P4 of MODELLING_GAPS.md sec.3.2, held back and never run
note: The second axis, and the only thing here that tells us whether the
coverage rule generalizes or whether we have one rule with a coat of
paint.  MODELLING_GAPS.md sec.3.2 pinned six candidate positives and
predicted, before anyone ran it, which would discriminate.  Two of
them land on this axis and this fixture catches both:
P3  M=-4, the lambda row G4 at u-weight 192 -- the missing interior
rung of the ladder 156,168,180,[192],204 that
full_system_bridge.G_generators() asserts.  AMBIGUOUS evidence
by MODELLING_GAPS's own reckoning: G4_stripped has divisor
4(0)+28(-1), so it has a PLACE story as well and would fire on
either axis.  It discriminates nothing and is not counted.
P4  M=0..12, the half-line.  THE CLEAN ITEM.  The pipeline consumes
only the M < 0 slices of P and of Q; every M >= 0 slice of
either is unconsumed.  There is no place story here at all -- a
truncation by sign of the slice index is an order phenomenon and
nothing else.  This is what makes ORDER a necessary axis.
So the discrimination requirement of MODELLING_GAPS.md sec.3.2 item 4
is met: deleting PLACE loses the t gap, deleting ORDER loses the
half-line, and neither axis catches the other's item.  What this does
NOT establish is that the rule discriminates WITHIN an axis -- that
needs more than one incident per axis, and sec.3.4 is explicit that
this repo does not contain one.

VACUOUS-CONCLUSION:INF-KSYZ-REV.note: NOT A RETRODICTION. New rule in v0.2.1. Genuine here: CL-KSYZ-ID is an IDENTITY concluding at GSYS_K, where CL-KSYZ (UNIT_IDEAL_CERT) proves emptiness -- the coordinate ring is the zero ring, so the rewriting holds trivially. The identity was established BEFORE the emptiness it helped prove, which is exactly the ordering the discharge asks to be recorded.

VACUOUS-CONCLUSION:INF-SLICEPHI.note: NOT A RETRODICTION. PREDICATE concluding at SLICEPHI, where CL-ATLE9-PHI (UNIT_IDEAL_CERT) proves emptiness.

VACUOUS-CONCLUSION:INF-SYZCOLL-DICT.note: NOT A RETRODICTION. IDENTITY concluding at SYZCOLL, where CL-ATLE9-SYZ (EXACT_VALUATION_COLLISION) proves emptiness.

ASSERTED-WITNESS:CL-C08-REAL.note: NOT A RETRODICTION. New rule in v0.3.1. And a sharp one here: CL-C08-REAL is the counter-claim that makes the C08 refusal a TRUE positive rather than a conservative one, and it is quoted from a lemma with no point exhibited. The thing grading the headline detection is itself unverified.

ASSERTED-WITNESS:CL-C20-REAL.note: NOT A RETRODICTION. Same lemma, same absence, same role for C20.

clean_inference_notes.INF-C08-CURRENT: the REPAIRED inference.  If this were flagged the framework could not tell a defect from its fix.
clean_inference_notes.INF-KSYZ-REV: the sharpest control: a direction that would be FORBIDDEN on a NECESSARY_CONDITION edge, licensed because the K-syzygy is an ideal EQUALITY.
